# Logo Strip

`logos/logo-strip` &middot; section-level &middot; category: logos

## Purpose

A row of logos with an optional label. Trusted-by, partners, clients and press layouts are variants.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `logos` | logos |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | text |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Four logos across.
- **trusted-by**: A "Trusted by" label above four logos on the page background color. Sets `background: @colors.background`.
- **partners**: Three larger partner logos. Sets `columns: 3`, `logoWidth: 140px`.
- **clients**: Six small client logos in one row. Sets `columns: 6`, `logoWidth: 64px`, `columnPadding: @spacing.xs`.
- **press**: Three press logos with generous space, on the surface color. Sets `columns: 3`, `logoWidth: 120px`, `paddingY: @spacing.xl`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mobileColumns` | one of `2`, `1` | `2` |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `columns` | one of `4`, `2`, `3`, `5`, `6` | `4` |
| `logoWidth` | length | `"100px"` |
| `labelColor` | text | `"@colors.mutedText"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `paddingY` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingY"` |
| `paddingX` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingX"` |
| `columnPadding` | spacing | `"@spacing.sm"` |
| `gap` | length | `"@spacing.xs"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `mobileColumns`: `2`, `1`. How many columns per row on phones.
- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Images with fixed widths, honored. | Fine. Alt text (the company name) shows when images are blocked. | Label swaps via dm-muted, logos are not recolored. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('logos/logo-strip', {
  "label": "Trusted by teams at",
  "logos": [
    {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/240x80/png?text=Northwind",
      "alt": "Northwind"
    },
    {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/240x80/png?text=Fabrikam",
      "alt": "Fabrikam"
    },
    {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/240x80/png?text=Contoso",
      "alt": "Contoso"
    },
    {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/240x80/png?text=Litware",
      "alt": "Litware"
    }
  ]
}) ]]
```
